Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.rail.signing

Class KfeQuorumPsbtSigningService

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.rail.signing.KfeQuorumPsbtSigningService
@Service public class KfeQuorumPsbtSigningService extends Object
Production PSBT signing for custodial on-chain outbounds.

Signers may be:

  • Vault mesh Taproot FROST (kfe.vaultmesh.mesh-only=true) — Intent-gated /v1/bitcoin/sign-psbt; no mpc fallback
  • Remote HTTP endpoints (quorum.psbt.signer-urls) — multiparty HSM/sidecar nodes
  • Local Bitcoin Core wallet (quorum.psbt.local-core-signer-enabled) via walletprocesspsbt — first-class when keys live in Core (or as one quorum seat)
Quorum requires required-signatures distinct successful signatures before combine → finalize → broadcast (mesh-only path treats the mesh as the sole signer seat).

  • Constructor Details

    • KfeQuorumPsbtSigningService

      @Autowired public KfeQuorumPsbtSigningService(org.springframework.beans.factory.ObjectProvider<BitcoinCoreRpcClient> bitcoinCoreRpcClient, @Qualifier("custodyRestTemplate") org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate restTemplate, com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper objectMapper, com.kerosene.common.vaultmesh.settlement.VaultMeshSettlementPort vaultMeshSettlementPort, @Value("${kfe.vaultmesh.mesh-only:false}") boolean meshOnly, @Value("${kfe.vaultmesh.default-bucket:USERS}") String meshBucket, @Value("${quorum.psbt.required-signatures:2}") int requiredSignatures, @Value("${quorum.psbt.funding-confirmation-target:6}") int fundingConfirmationTarget, @Value("${quorum.psbt.signer-urls:}") String signerUrls, @Value("${quorum.psbt.signer-api-keys:}") String signerApiKeys, @Value("${quorum.psbt.signer-ids:}") String signerIds, @Value("${quorum.psbt.require-signer-identity:true}") boolean requireSignerIdentity, @Value("${quorum.psbt.local-core-signer-enabled:false}") boolean localCoreSignerEnabled, @Value("${quorum.psbt.local-core-signer-id:bitcoin-core-wallet}") String localCoreSignerId, @Value("${quorum.psbt.signer-tls-fingerprints:}") String signerTlsFingerprints)
      Creates the production signer from application dependencies and quorum security settings. Mesh-only mode forcibly disables local and remote legacy signer paths; quorum sizes and confirmation targets are clamped to at least one before use.
      Parameters:
      bitcoinCoreRpcClient - provider for the optional Bitcoin Core wallet RPC adapter
      restTemplate - HTTP client configured for custody signer calls
      objectMapper - JSON serializer and parser for signer traffic and metadata
      vaultMeshSettlementPort - intent-gated Vault mesh signing port
      meshOnly - whether all signing must pass through Vault mesh
      meshBucket - Vault mesh bucket to bind to signing intents
      requiredSignatures - minimum distinct cryptographic signatures required
      fundingConfirmationTarget - default confirmation target for coin selection
      signerUrls - comma-separated remote signer endpoint URLs
      signerApiKeys - comma-separated bearer tokens aligned with signer URLs
      signerIds - comma-separated signer identities aligned with signer URLs
      requireSignerIdentity - whether an HTTP signer must report its configured identity
      localCoreSignerEnabled - whether Bitcoin Core may act as one signer seat
      localCoreSignerId - identity label for the local Bitcoin Core signer
      signerTlsFingerprints - identity-to-certificate fingerprint allowlist

    • preflight

      public KfeQuorumPsbtSigningService.OnchainFundingPreflight preflight(KfeOnchainPaymentGateway.OnchainPreflightCommand command)
      Funds a provisional PSBT and reports the fee/hash and currently configured signer capacity. The provisional PSBT is not signed or broadcast; it supports quoting before payment execution.
      Parameters:
      command - destination, amount, and fee cap to evaluate
      Returns:
      funding fee, stable PSBT digest, and available signer-seat count
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - when Bitcoin Core or enough signer seats are unavailable

    • prepare

      public KfeOnchainPaymentGateway.PreparedOnchainPayment prepare(KfeOnchainPaymentGateway.OnchainPaymentCommand command)
      Funds, signs, verifies, and finalizes a transaction without broadcasting it. Reserved inputs are unlocked on runtime failure so a failed signing attempt does not unnecessarily block later wallet operations.
      Parameters:
      command - authorized payment details, optional fee rate, and signer intent
      Returns:
      finalized transaction and integrity hashes ready for a separately controlled broadcast
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - when funding, quorum, signing, or integrity checks fail

    • broadcast

      public KfeQuorumPsbtSigningService.OnchainExecution broadcast(KfeOnchainPaymentGateway.PreparedOnchainPayment prepared)
      Revalidates a prepared transaction, checks mempool policy, broadcasts it, and distinguishes confirmed-known, mempool, rejected, and ambiguous outcomes for idempotent reconciliation.
      Parameters:
      prepared - finalized transaction returned by prepare(com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.rail.onchain.KfeOnchainPaymentGateway.OnchainPaymentCommand)
      Returns:
      execution result for a transaction known to Bitcoin Core
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when hashes, txid, policy, or transaction data are invalid
      KfeOnchainPaymentGateway.ProviderExecutionAmbiguous - when broadcast may have succeeded
